_about: A small FICTIONAL web used for offline mode. Every company, person, domain and number here is invented for teaching. All domains end in .example (a reserved, never-real TLD). The pages are deliberately messy: outdated pages, copied press releases, a look-alike company, a low-quality rumour blog and one page carrying a prompt-injection attack.

documents.title: About NimbusPay — Payment gateway for Indian businesses
documents.text: About NimbusPay. NimbusPay Technologies Pvt Ltd is a payment gateway for online businesses in India. The company was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, India. Leadership: CEO Ananya Rao has led the company since January 2026. Co-founder Rohit Mehra now serves as Chief Product Officer. NimbusPay holds final authorisation as a Payment Aggregator; the registration can be verified on the regulator's public registry. Today NimbusPay processes card, UPI and net-banking payments for more than 18,000 merchants.

documents.title: A letter from our founder (2023)
documents.text: Dear merchants, this is founder and CEO Rohit Mehra. Four years ago we started NimbusPay in Bengaluru to make online payments simple for small Indian businesses. Last year we raised $8 million in a Series A to grow the team. We have also applied to the central bank for a payment aggregator licence. Thank you for trusting us with your payments.

documents.title: Payment Aggregator Registry — NimbusPay Technologies Pvt Ltd
documents.text: Payment Aggregator Registry. Entity: NimbusPay Technologies Pvt Ltd, Bengaluru, India. Category: online payment aggregator. In-principle approval issued: 3 March 2024. Status: final authorisation granted on 14 August 2025. Registration is valid and active as on the last review date.

documents.title: NimbusPay gets in-principle nod for payment aggregator licence
documents.text: Bengaluru-based payment gateway NimbusPay has received in-principle approval to operate as a payment aggregator, the company said on Tuesday. Founder and CEO Rohit Mehra said the final licence could take a year. The startup serves around 9,000 merchants across India.

documents.title: NimbusPay raises $40 million Series B led by Horizon Ventures
documents.text: BENGALURU, 18 November 2025 — NimbusPay, a payment gateway for Indian online businesses, today announced it has raised $40 million in a Series B round led by Horizon Ventures, with participation from existing investors. The company will use the funds to expand its merchant base and invest in reliability. CEO Rohit Mehra said the round validates the company's focus on small merchants.

documents.title: Why investors backed NimbusPay's $40 million round
documents.text: NimbusPay raised $40 million in its Series B, valuing the Bengaluru payment gateway at roughly $300 million, according to two people familiar with the deal. Investors pointed to strong merchant growth in India, though some merchants have complained about settlement delays. The company had raised $8 million in a Series A in 2022.

documents.title: Is NimbusPay shutting down?? (rumours)
documents.text: Lots of rumours on social media that NimbusPay may shut down soon!! Nobody has confirmed anything. What we know: NimbusPay raised $8 million in a Series A this year and CEO Rohit Mehra is still in charge. They charge 1.5% per transaction on domestic cards, which is cheap for small Indian merchants. Make your own decision, payments people.

documents.title: NimbusPay System Status
documents.text: All systems operational. NimbusPay payments platform, India region: 99.95% uptime over the last 90 days. Past incidents: outage on 12 January 2026 — card payments failed for about 2 hours because of a database failover; resolved and post-mortem published. No other major incidents in 2026.

documents.title: Is NimbusPay down right now?
documents.text: Our Indian checkout is failing — NimbusPay card payments returning errors since 11:05. Anyone else? Reply: same here, looks like a full outage on 12 January 2026. Reply: back up after about two hours, their status page now shows the incident.

documents.title: NimbusPay reviews — ReviewHub
documents.text: NimbusPay payment gateway, India. Average rating 3.9/5 from 412 merchant reviews. Merchants like the easy onboarding and UPI support. The most common complaint is settlement delays during festival sales. Several reviews mention helpful support but slow dispute resolution.

documents.title: NimbusPay Pricing
documents.text: Simple pricing for Indian businesses. Standard plan: 2.0% per transaction on domestic cards. International cards: 3.0% per transaction. UPI payments are free for merchants. No setup fee. Pricing effective from 1 April 2026.

documents.title: Payment gateway fees in India compared (2024)
documents.text: We compared five gateways popular with Indian startups. NimbusPay charges 1.8% per transaction on domestic cards, which is among the lowest we found. PayQuick charges 2.1%. Prices change often, so always check the official pricing page before you sign.

documents.title: NimbusPay discloses exposure of merchant contact data
documents.text: Indian payment gateway NimbusPay has disclosed a security incident: a misconfigured storage bucket exposed names and email addresses of some merchants for about three days in June 2025. The company said no card data was exposed and that affected merchants were notified. Independent researchers who found the bucket confirmed the company's account.

documents.title: Security notice — June 2025
documents.text: Security notice. On 16 June 2025 we found a misconfigured storage bucket that exposed merchant contact details (names and email addresses). No card data was exposed. The bucket was secured within hours of discovery, affected merchants in India were notified, and an external audit has been completed.

documents.title: Nimbus Pay Ltd — Payroll software for UK small businesses
documents.text: Nimbus Pay Ltd makes payroll software for small businesses in the United Kingdom. The company was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Manchester. CEO Daniel Hughes leads a team of 60 people. Nimbus Pay Ltd is not a payment gateway.

documents.title: NimbusPay names Ananya Rao chief executive
documents.text: Bengaluru payment gateway NimbusPay has appointed Ananya Rao as CEO, effective January 2026. Co-founder Rohit Mehra, who led the company since 2019, moves to the role of Chief Product Officer. Rao previously ran merchant operations at a large Indian bank.
